events.title: The Demo is live. Come make yourself at home.
events.summary: The Odd Eggs Demo is live on Steam! Build a little island, set up production, and watch the cats get busy. Or just stop for a minute and enjoy the view. Played it? Tell us what you loved, what felt clunky, or what you'd like to see next. We'd love to see your island, too. Come hang out on Discord See you on the island!
